messages:
tess: opened a focused PR to tweak the model-catalog benchmarks page and polarion4b model-card. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/548
tess: main updates: add 95% latency percentile column, clarify "effective_seq" vs "max_seq", swap legacy curl examples for SDK v3 snippets, and pin benchmark rows to bench-runner commit 2026-05-12-a1b2c3
omar: nice. can you also add a short note on the bench variance? customers ask why numbers move between runs
tess: added a small "bench variance" blurb: "benchmarks are median of 5 runs; variability shown as 95% CI. differences may arise from transient scheduling and tokenizer model mismatch."
lee: saw the latency percentile column  can we label it "p95 (ms)" and include measurement conditions in the table caption (seq length, reserved prefix)?
tess: updated header to "p95 (ms)" and caption now includes: "measurement: padded prompt 64 tokens, runner commit 2026-05-12-a1b2c3"
sam: on the model-card compatibility section, please add a one-liner about edge-quant behavior  ops wants something short for release notes
tess: added: "edge-quant may evict older KV buckets at different bucket boundaries vs classic quant; apps needing stable KV retention should pin a compat/legacy variant."
omar: good. tiny doc nit: in the limits matrix clarify "max_seq" as model capability and "effective_seq" as runtime-available after reserved tokens. users keep conflating them
tess: added the line and a tiny ascii table: 
```
| field | meaning |
|------|---------|
|max_seq| model absolute max tokens |
|effective_seq| max_seq - reserved_prefix_tokens |
```
lee: embed-sharding example looks fine but call out tokenizer differences and show using /tokenize first; also change the shard math to ceil(total_tokens/shard_size)
tess: added a short tokenization note and this python sketch:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
counts = [c.tokenize(t) for t in texts]  # model-specific tokens
shard_size = 1500
num_shards = (sum(counts) + shard_size - 1) // shard_size
```
sam: docs-bot linkcheck flagged one broken anchor earlier. any other external 404s?
docs-bot: linkcheck report: 1 broken anchor (runtime-router anchor), 1 external 404 fixed (benchmarks), re-run scheduled on merge
omar: can you pin the benchmark CSV path to /benchmarks/polarion/2026-05-a1b2c3.csv so it doesn't rot
tess: pinned CSV path and referenced the runner commit in the table caption. also added a short "SLO guardrails" callout: if p95 increases >20% after migration, follow the Dedicated quickrun: pin, mirror 1% test traffic, open support ticket to resize pools
lee: LGTM. squash small typo commits and then merge after docs-bot is green
tess: will squash and merge after green. thanks everyone :seedling:
